guide.antarchy.entry.introduction.title: SYSTEM INITIALIZED
guide.antarchy.entry.introduction.subtit: A machine for remembering what should have stayed forgotten.
guide.antarchy.entry.introduction.descri: Insert recovered floppy disks to expand this archive.
guide.antarchy.entry.toreterror.title: Toreterror
guide.antarchy.entry.toreterror_arena.de: This archive can trace the nearest Toreterror Arena for you, always somewhere in an Elythia Ocean.
Toreterror is an ancient turtle that fights with a water cannon at range and a long spinning charge up close, ricocheting off obstacles until it connects.
guide.antarchy.entry.elythia.title: Elythia
guide.antarchy.entry.elythia.subtitle: Dimension and portal access record
guide.antarchy.entry.elythia.description: Right-click a Brown Ant to teleport there directly, or sacrifice one inside a Mossy Ouranwood frame to light a permanent, reusable portal.
Cloud Sea only forms high in the sky, and only in about one in five regions up there. Elythia Ocean is where Toreterror Arenas are found.
guide.antarchy.entry.flying_squirrel.des: You wanna get nuts? Let’s get nuts.
Flying squirrels like nuts, trees, and dramatic exits. Feed one to befriend it, then give it plenty of canopy to climb through.
It may perch on top of your head. This is adorable, but it does make looking upward needlessly complicated.
If it falls, do not panic. It may be gliding. If you fall, you have my permission to panic.
guide.antarchy.disk.glimmer.title: GLIMMER FIELD GUIDE
guide.antarchy.entry.glimmer.title: Glimmer
guide.antarchy.entry.glimmer.subtitle: Bottled companion and variant record
guide.antarchy.entry.glimmer.description: Glimmers are common around Elythia's Glimmering Pools, and rarely appear after dark in Ouranwood Forest, the Elythia Meadow, and the Peach Forest. A wild one caught in daylight away from a pool fades out.
Feed a wild Glimmer a Spirit Apple to tame it. An empty-handed right-click cycles it between following, wandering, and sitting.
A tamed Glimmer can be bottled: right-click it with an empty glass bottle to capture it, cooldowns and all. Right-click the bottle again anywhere to release it.

Variant depends on where it was born. Glimmering Pools produce Frogs, Ouranwood Deer, and Apple Cows. Ouranwood Forest produces Frogs and Deer. The Elythia Meadow produces Apple Cows, and the Peach Forest produces Elkas. The Ant variant is not tied to any habitat; it only appears on a random roll.
Apple Cow: hunger drains 25 percent slower, and it grants a burst of Saturation and Regeneration when your food runs low. Ouranwood Deer: Speed I, and it knocks back hostile mobs you sprint into.

Frog: Jump Boost I, and it can devour a nearby hostile mob, growing bigger and stronger for a while. Ant: slightly longer attack reach, and a solid hit on something large grants a burst of Strength II.
Elka: Bloodglass Ward II. When one of those ward hearts breaks, it shatters into a shockwave around you.
guide.antarchy.entry.cavaryn.title: Cavaryn
guide.antarchy.entry.cavaryn.subtitle: Dimension and portal access record
guide.antarchy.entry.cavaryn.description: Right-click a Termite to teleport there directly, or sacrifice one inside a Myrmite frame to light a permanent, reusable portal.
Staying in one spot, killing hostiles, or breaking eggs raises local mob attention. Push it far enough and a swarm finds you; moving on lets an area cool down.
Glowcap, Biowart, Moleworm, Wormy, and Brooding Tunnel regions escalate differently, so which biome you are in matters as much as how long you have been there.
guide.antarchy.entry.thoraxis.title: Thoraxis
guide.antarchy.entry.thoraxis.subtitle: Dimension and portal access record
guide.antarchy.entry.thoraxis.descriptio: Right-click a Red Ant to teleport there directly, or sacrifice one inside a Nyxite frame to light a permanent, reusable portal.
Do not assume Nether rules: beds fail, respawn anchors work, the sky never lightens, and gravity flips once you cross far enough below center.

Bluestone runs like Redstone's mirror image: the same wiring, but reacting the opposite way. The Vortex Lens shows it best: Redstone pulls, Bluestone pushes. Antimetal blocks reverse gravity locally and have their own rail system.
Vertical progression runs Dream Dunes, Umbral Hills, Lucid Pools, and Nadir Forest, though height is a tendency, not a guaranteed layer.
Dimensional tears spawn in linked pairs. Step through one and you're pulled to its twin, with your gravity flipped for a while after.
guide.antarchy.entry.temporal_fields.sub: Time dilation, contraction, and Chronosphere reference
guide.antarchy.entry.temporal_fields.des: Time Dilation and Time Contraction change how fast affected entities experience the world.

A worn Chronosphere creates a permanent field around you at 35 percent speed. Field radius is 1.5 blocks at level 1, 2.5 at level 2, and 3.5 at level 3+; entities are affected out to twice that radius.

The effect reaches living entities, projectiles, and dropped items, and anything fired from inside a field keeps that field's speed. Overlapping fields do not stack; the slower or faster rule wins. Kings and Queens are immune to it.
guide.antarchy.entry.bloodglass.title: Bloodglass
guide.antarchy.entry.bloodglass.subtitle: Reactive protection system
guide.antarchy.entry.bloodglass.descript: Blood Crystal armor grants Bloodglass Hearts that absorb one hit, shatter, and recharge.
Each equipped piece adds one heart, and every heart recharges on its own 30-second timer. A Blood Crystal Apple grants two temporary charges lasting 2 minutes, on top of the armor's hearts.
The Katana has a longer reach than it looks, a brief hit-immunity window right after each dash, and a short cooldown before it can dash again.
guide.antarchy.entry.vortex.title: Vortex
guide.antarchy.entry.vortex.subtitle: Vortex Lens and Eye of the Storm reference
guide.antarchy.entry.vortex.description: The Vortex Lens pulls or pushes depending on signal: Redstone pulls, Bluestone pushes.
guide.antarchy.entry.vortex.description2: Signal strength scales its size: a 1.5 to 10-block pull radius, with height from 3 to 20 blocks. It deals no damage on its own.
guide.antarchy.entry.vortex.description3: The Eye of the Storm launches an updraft and a homing tornado on its own trigger, unlike the Lens's signal-controlled field.
guide.antarchy.entry.nightmare.title: Nightmare
guide.antarchy.entry.nightmare.subtitle: Thoraxis hostile entity record
guide.antarchy.entry.nightmare.descripti: Recorded in the deepest Thoraxis regions.
Its attacks hit harder the lower your health is, so a bad fight gets worse fast.
Past half health it takes to the air and opens a pair of portals, stepping through one to teleport behind you and strike. Watch both portals, not just the one it disappears into.
guide.antarchy.entry.high_fructose_corn_: Field notes on a suspiciously popular bottle
Brew it by adding Corn, found wild or grown as a crop, to a Water Bottle.
Drunk on its own, it causes four seconds of Nausea. A doctor would not recommend it.
Used on any food in a crafting grid, it Americanizes it: extra nutrition, extra saturation, and a burst of Regeneration.
guide.antarchy.entry.rainbow_ant.title: Rainbow Ant
guide.antarchy.entry.rainbow_ant.descrip: Feed a Rainbow Ant Rainbow Sugar to assign it a destination, then interact with it again to travel there. The destination is stored on that ant, so keep it alive.
guide.antarchy.entry.easter_bunny.title: Easter Bunny
guide.antarchy.entry.easter_bunny.descri: The Easter Bunny lays spawn eggs for all sorts of creatures! Life is like an easter egg, you never know what you're gonna get.
Feed them carrots, golden carrots, or dandelions.
guide.antarchy.entry.duplicator_tree.des: A mature Duplicator Tree copies a nearby solid block into an empty, supported space next to it.
Fluids, block entities, and other Duplicator Tree blocks will not copy, and duplication happens occasionally, not on a fixed timer.
guide.antarchy.disk.kraken.title: KRAKEN SIGHTING NOTES
guide.antarchy.entry.kraken.title: Kraken
guide.antarchy.entry.kraken.subtitle: Overworld aquatic encounter
guide.antarchy.entry.kraken.description: Kill a Squid while under Bad Omen to summon a Kraken where it died. Higher Bad Omen levels raise the odds.
guide.antarchy.entry.kraken.description2: It only spawns in open water, so pick your fight where it can actually surface.
guide.antarchy.disk.king.title: KING'S TREE FIELD NOTES
guide.antarchy.entry.king.title: King
guide.antarchy.entry.king.subtitle: Elythia royal entity record
guide.antarchy.entry.king.description: Find the massive King's Tree in Elythia. The King spawns and patrols near it.
guide.antarchy.entry.king.description2: Mid-fight he issues a decree, such as KNEEL, COME NO CLOSER, or SHOW NO MERCY. Obey quickly.
guide.antarchy.entry.king.description3: Breaking a decree halves your hearts for 30 seconds and calls down his judgment.
guide.antarchy.disk.queen.title: QUEEN HAVOC TRAIL NOTES
guide.antarchy.entry.queen.title: Queen
guide.antarchy.entry.queen.subtitle: Thoraxis royal entity record
guide.antarchy.entry.queen.description: Follow a Queen Havoc Trail through Thoraxis's underside to find her chamber.
guide.antarchy.entry.queen.description2: She fights with gravity: a ground stomp with an expanding shockwave, black holes that pull you toward their center, and a crushing field that pins you along the current gravity direction.
guide.antarchy.entry.queen.description3: In her final phase she also casts her own time dilation field, slowing anyone caught inside it.
guide.antarchy.entry.prince.title: Prince
guide.antarchy.entry.prince.subtitle: Royal mount record
guide.antarchy.entry.prince.description: Prince Eggs hatch into small Princes that grow when fed golden items.
guide.antarchy.entry.prince.description2: A grown Prince can be tamed and saddled for flight, fires elemental bolts at your enemies, and can command nearby hostile mobs. Feed responsibly; you are raising a small flying warlord.
guide.antarchy.entry.princess.title: Princess
guide.antarchy.entry.princess.subtitle: Royal mount record
guide.antarchy.entry.princess.descriptio: Princess Eggs hatch into small Princesses that grow when fed golden items.
A grown Princess can be tamed and saddled for flight, fires elemental bolts, and creates time-dilation fields around enemies.
